title: Business Architecture — Scaffolding & Iterative Planning
tagline: Each iteration adds structure, complexity, and a fortress of value.
summary: The modern business plan is an evolving document — a mechanism for continuous planning, not a static funding requirement. Build like a reef: low-floor accessibility, high-ceiling extensibility, just-in-time feedback.

learningObjectives.statement: Apply the BizChat methodology to move a rough idea from voice-captured draft to polished pitch using low-floor and high-ceiling tools.
Construct the core components of an iterative business plan: an executive summary, an evidence-based market analysis, and a future-of-the-company section.
Formulate sharp, expert-directed help-seeking questions that reduce reputational risk and elicit high-quality coaching.

activities.title: Low-floor / high-ceiling tooling and just-in-time AI feedback
Voice-to-text a draft, then revise with deepening & bridging prompts
Future of the company: scalability & sustainability
Draft 5 questions to ask an expert; peer-rank them

assessments.method: Submit a draft-to-pitch revision trail showing at least two iterations
assessments.successCriteria: Revision trail shows a measurable improvement guided by feedback prompts.

assessments.method: Submit a 3-part iterative business plan draft
assessments.successCriteria: All three components present; market analysis cites at least one external evidence source.

assessments.method: Submit 5 expert-directed questions with a rationale for each
assessments.successCriteria: At least 3 questions are specific, answerable by an expert, and reduce a named risk.
